fields.name: site
fields.label: Site
fields.schema_description: Site containing the SpX overlay to delete.

options.notes: From useEnvData (useEnvData.ts:34-41). The UI value is 'dcim-location:["<location_type>","<id>"]' when the row has location_type (location-options.ts:21-36).

fields.query_param_normalization: Once locations load, the value is resolved by encoded value, id, or display name. It is replaced only while the current value is empty or still equals the raw query, and an unresolvable value becomes '' (spx-overlay-deletion-workflow-form.tsx:89-104).
client_only_validation: Trimmed min 1 'Site is required' (:44); the schema has no minLength
fields.submit_transform: The encoded option is decoded: site = option id, or the raw value if no option matches. The location type is emitted as site_type (:136-139).

fields.name: overlay_id
fields.label: Overlay ID
fields.schema_description: Identifier of the SpX overlay to delete.

options.notes: useOverlays({enabled: Boolean(site), isolationType: SPX_OVERLAY_ISOLATION_TYPE, location: site}) (:79-87; useOverlays.ts:40-78). There is no request until a site is selected. location and location_type are split from the encoded site value. The endpoint returns {id, name} (parameter_v1.py:183-218); the UI uses name for both label and value (useOverlays.ts:66-69).

fields.query_param_normalization: useSyncSelectFromQuery: after the site's overlays load, the value is kept only if it equals an option value, otherwise it becomes '' (:113-120).
client_only_validation: Disabled until a site is selected (:182)

fields.name: namespace_tag
fields.label: Namespace Tag
fields.schema_description: Tag identifying the namespace used for allocation.

options.notes: useNamespaceTags(selectedSite) (useNamespaceTags.ts:31-58). It fetches unfiltered when no site is selected. A current value not among the loaded options is cleared to '' (:122-132).

fields.query_param_normalization: namespace_tag, falling back to the alias 'namespace', falling back to 'spectrumx' (:55-58). The specs use '&namespace=' (spxOverlayDeletionForm.spec.ts:69). The value is cleared if it is not in the loaded options.
client_only_validation: Value must exist in the loaded options or it is cleared (:122-132)

fields.name: site_type
fields.schema_description: DCIM location type for the site identifier.
fields.widget_today: none (derived from the selected site option)
fields.submit_transform: location.locationType (:139). The key is omitted when undefined.

payload_transform: onSubmit (spx-overlay-deletion-workflow-form.tsx:134-154) builds {site: option?.id ?? data.site, site_type: option?.locationType, overlay_id, namespace_tag} and POSTs it to /v1/workflow/ngc/spx_overlay_deletion. The key order matches the model declaration order, and undefined site_type is dropped.
discrepancies: The schema overlay_id is a free string ('Identifier of the SpX overlay'), but the UI restricts it to existing spectrum_x_vrf overlays at the site and submits the overlay row's 'name', not its 'id' (useOverlays.ts:66-69, parameter_v1.py:183-218).
namespace_tag is optional in the schema (default 'spectrumx') but required in the UI, which also clears it when it is not in the site's options.
The UI requires site to be non-empty; the schema has no minLength.
contract_gaps: The overlay and namespace-tag depends_on need location and location_type derived from the encoded site option, not a sibling field's raw value.
query_param takes a single name, but namespace_tag accepts 'namespace_tag' or the alias 'namespace'.

Option sources differ when the dependency is empty: overlays are disabled with no request, while namespace tags are fetched unfiltered. Clearing a dependent value when its parent changes is also unspecified.
Renderer behaviour is unspecified for a default or prefilled select value missing from the loaded async options (here it is cleared).
